fields.System.Title: FDN-507 — Create virtual locations
fields.System.Description:
Story

As a developer, I want virtual locations to exist for supplier, customer, loss, gain, and
in-transit, so that every movement is a transfer between two locations and the ledger
always balances.

Acceptance criteria

  • - Given a new warehouse, then the five virtual locations are created automatically.
  • - Given a virtual location, then it is flagged as virtual and excluded from availability
  • calculations.
  • - Given a virtual location, then putaway, picking, and replenishment never suggest it.
  • - Given a virtual location, then it cannot be retired.
  • - Given any sequence of movements, then total quantity across all locations — real and
  • virtual — is unchanged.

Traceability

| Aspect | Detail |
|---|---|
| Modules | masterdata, inventory |
| Tables | location |
| Risks | Without these, adjustments are a special case handled separately everywhere ([doc 03 §4](../../../docs/03-master-data.md)) |
| Tests | unit · integration · invariant (conservation of total quantity) |
